clue.text: Vehicle a doctor used, pinched by such a braggart

indicators.note: being pinched by something means being squeezed between its parts, so the other pieces sit within the word such

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
MO is short for Medical Officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A boastful man is squeezed into a car with a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pinched by' is the container signal; 'such' is fodder, not a link to the definition, and 'used' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Scaramouch is the boastful, cowardly stock clown of Italian comedy, hence any braggart.

clue.text: Goes quickly up to work at wheel

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: to nip is to go quickly, so goes quickly is nips

explanation.surface: Someone hurries off to work at a wheel, perhaps a potter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns NIPS round to give SPIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Spinning is the craft of working wool into yarn at a spinning wheel.

clue.text: Comrade missing start of political gathering

indicators.note: missing its start means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a rally is a mass political meeting

explanation.surface: A comrade fails to turn up at the beginning of a political meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing start of' takes R off RALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: An ally is a friend or supporter on your side, a comrade.

clue.text: Strike about fee covering learner's item in sports programme

parts.note: industrial action is a strike by workers
re is Latin for concerning, about

indicators.note: covering means the fee word goes round the learner letter

parts.note: pay is a fee or wage
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Workers strike over a payment that includes something for a trainee, in a sports broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' is the container signal; strike here is industrial action, not a blow.
explanation.definitionFit: An action replay is a rerun of a moment of play, a regular feature of televised sport.

clue.text: Flag made of gold or silver lace?

definitions.meaning: a flag is an iris, and ... is a kind of iris
an old name for lace or braid made of gold or silver thread

explanation.definitionFit: Orris names both an iris plant (a flag) and an ornamental lace of gold or silver thread.

clue.text: Report of European partner's final defeat

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the words are taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: a partner from the Czech Republic is a Czech mate

explanation.surface: News of a European's spouse losing at the last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report of' signals sound: CZECH MATE sounds like the chess term.
explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate ends a chess game with the king trapped, so it is a final defeat.

clue.text: Work in university, involved in surgical procedures

indicators.note: being involved in something here means placed inside it

parts.note: ops are surgical operations

explanation.surface: Research at a university that involves surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' puts U inside OPS.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a work, especially a musical composition.

clue.text: For Leonardo, virtually everything is unsophisticated

parts.note: pro is Latin for for, in favour of
Leonardo da Vinci, the Renaissance artist

indicators.note: virtually means nearly all, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: In Leonardo's view, almost everything is naive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'virtually' cuts ALL to AL. 'is' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Provincial describes narrow, unsophisticated outlooks associated with places away from the capital.

clue.text: Moving unsteadily and causing "astonishment

definitions.meaning: as an adjective: astounding, amazing, causing great surprise

explanation.definitionFit: Staggering is both walking unsteadily and, as an adjective, astonishing.

clue.text: Doomed state briefly played leading role

parts.note: ILL is the abbreviation for Illinois, a US state
an actor who starred played the lead

explanation.surface: A doomed production in which someone played the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: ILL is a short form of Illinois.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill-starred means born under an unlucky star, so fated to fail.

clue.text: Piece of furniture I removed from European capital

indicators.note: removed from means the letter is taken out of the word that follows

parts.note: Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria

explanation.surface: Someone takes a piece of furniture from a European city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed from' takes I out of SOFIA.
explanation.definitionFit: A sofa is an upholstered seat for several people, a piece of furniture.

clue.text: Agonising tendency in judicial investigation

indicators.note: in places the tendency word inside the investigation word

parts.note: a hearing is a court's examination of a case
a trend is a tendency

explanation.surface: A painful pattern shows up in a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal; heart-rending is hyphenated, so the count is (5-7).
explanation.definitionFit: Heart-rending means causing great sorrow, so agonising to witness.

clue.text: Shopper's money secures old service in Handel's initial harmony '

indicators.note: to secure is to hold inside, so the old service goes within the other letters
an initial is the first letter of a name

parts.note: keeping means harmony, as in the phrase in keeping
use means service, as in of service or of use

explanation.surface: A shopper pays for an old church service set within Handel's music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'secures' is the container signal; housekeeping here is the household budget, not the chores. 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Housekeeping is the household budget used for buying food and supplies.

clue.text: Bird uses church if beginning to feed on husks

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

parts.note: chaff is the husks separated from grain

explanation.surface: A bird uses the churchyard as a place to start feeding on grain husks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uses' and 'on' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: The chiffchaff is a small European warbler named for its song.

clue.text: Having posh quarters in hostelry, makes insinuations

parts.note: an inn is a hostelry
U means upper-class, posh
E and N, east and north, are compass quarters
does means makes, as in does a meal

explanation.surface: A guest with grand rooms at an inn starts dropping hints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having' and 'in' are link words; the pieces run in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Innuendoes are indirect suggestions, usually disparaging or suggestive, so insinuations.

clue.text: Woman introduces a display, returning fees paid

parts.note: Honor is a woman's name

indicators.note: returning means the display word is read backwards

parts.note: to air something is to display it

explanation.surface: A woman puts on a show and gets her money back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns AIR into RIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Honoraria are fees paid voluntarily for professional services nominally given free.

clue.text: Act for soldiers: dispatched to support theatre company

indicators.note: in a down clue, a supporting piece sits beneath the one it holds up

parts.note: a rep is a repertory theatre company
RE is the Royal Engineers
sent means dispatched

explanation.surface: Troops are sent to back up a touring theatre company.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'to support' places RE and SENT below REP.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent someone is to act for them, as an agent or deputy.

clue.text: Come back to mind extremely rare dog?

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A rare mongrel keeps coming back into one's thoughts.
explanation.definitionFit: Recur means to happen again, as a thought keeps returning to the mind.

clue.text: Dowdy woman goes in to quaff rum-punch

indicators.note: the answer goes in among the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A plain woman downs a rum punch.
explanation.definitionFit: A frump is a woman who dresses in a dull, old-fashioned way.

clue.text: Raid Peron 'contrived to decree in advance

indicators.note: something contrived is artificially arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A raid by Peron was planned in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: Peron was the Argentine president.
explanation.definitionFit: To preordain is to decide or fix beforehand, decreeing it in advance.

clue.text: Recuperating criminal taking fragrant air of glen?

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
a vale is a valley, like a glen
a scent is a fragrant smell in the air

explanation.surface: A convict recovers by breathing the sweet air of the Highlands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' and 'of' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Convalescent describes someone recovering their health after illness.

clue.text: Unfinished monument overlooking old African city

indicators.note: unfinished means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a cairn is a mound of stones raised as a memorial

explanation.surface: An incomplete monument looks out over an ancient African city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overlooking' in a down entry puts CAIR above O.
explanation.definitionFit: Cairo is the capital of Egypt, a city in Africa.

clue.text: Venetian traveller's sweater

definitions.meaning: Marco ..., the Venetian who travelled to China

explanation.definitionFit: Polo names both Marco Polo, the Venetian explorer, and a polo-neck jumper.

clue.text: Accustomed to being taken advantage of

explanation.definitionFit: Used means both accustomed (used to) and exploited by another.

clue.text: Unidentified writer's. article about foreign drama

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the drama word is reversed

parts.note: No (or Noh) is classical Japanese drama

explanation.surface: An anonymous author writes on Japanese theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns NO into ON. The apostrophe s stands for is.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon, short for anonymous, signs work whose writer is unknown.

clue.text: Apt to draw out nothing, getting into endless trouble

indicators.note: getting into means placed inside the following word
endless means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: fuss is bother, trouble
to elicit is to draw out
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: It is fitting to coax out nothing and get into a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims the trouble word and 'getting into' is the container signal; 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Felicitous means well chosen and suitable, so apt.

clue.text: European abandons banquet to practise abstinence

indicators.note: abandons means the European letter leaves the banquet word

parts.note: a feast is a banquet

explanation.surface: A European walks out on a feast in order to go without.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandons' takes E out of FEAST.
explanation.definitionFit: To fast is to go without food, a form of abstinence.

clue.text: Keep 'Malay garment? Time for a pause

indicators.note: time for a means the time letter replaces the letter a

parts.note: a sarong is a wrap-around skirt worn in Malaysia
a hold is a pause, as in on hold

explanation.surface: Keep the Malay wrap on, it is time to take a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' replaces A in SARONG with T to give STRONG.
explanation.definitionFit: A keep is the stronghold tower of a castle.
